representativeSnapshot.kind: production-like disposable database with organization owner, organization admin, tour collaborator, invitee, and unrelated-user personas

rowCountQueries: Count events_v2 rows by org_id, status, and schedule-null state
Confirm every tour used by quick start has a non-null org_id
Record grants, RLS policies, and constraint validation state for tours, events_v2, tour_events, tour_team_members, tour_teams, tour_vendors, and tour_artists
Confirm no existing row has only one of start_at or end_at populated
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: No existing data is rewritten; event rows are created only by explicit authenticated quick-start requests and invitations only by explicit organizer actions

execution.resumeStrategy: All schema objects and policies converge additively; event creation replays by quick_start_batch_id and ordinal; invitation acceptance converges by invitation id and accepted user
execution.idempotency: The RPC returns the original ordered batch for the same batch id and count, rejects mismatched reuse, and the partial unique index prevents duplicate ordinals

quarantine.strategy: No tenant ownership is inferred or backfilled. Quick-start events inherit org_id from an explicitly authorized tour.

constraints: Unscheduled rows require both timestamps null and inquiry status
Scheduled rows require both timestamps and end_at greater than start_at
Quick-start batch and ordinal must be present together with ordinal between 1 and 50
Invitation role, channel, state, delivery state, and target binding allowlists
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Validate NOT VALID event constraints after checking legacy schedule integrity, then test batch bounds, replay, mismatched-key conflicts, invitation identity binding, and the collaborator RLS matrix

recovery.rollback: Stop mounting the quick-start wizard and stop issuing invitation links; preserve additive columns, event drafts, invitation audit records, and memberships
recovery.forwardFix: Apply a later reviewed additive function, policy, constraint-validation, or index migration; do not reset or rewrite the database

queries: Verify new event columns, indexes, and NOT VALID constraints
Verify quick-start batches contain exactly one row per requested ordinal and one assignment per event
Verify raw invitation tokens are absent and only SHA-256 hashes are stored
Verify organizer, collaborator, invitee, expired invite, identity mismatch, and unrelated-user access
Verify collaborators cannot read unrelated tours, organization finance, billing, or organization settings
Verify unscheduled inquiry drafts are absent from calendar, upcoming metrics, ticket totals, and logistics queues
